notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[h3]Dear friends![/h3]

[h3]A bunch of cutscenes have been added to the game, intro + victory cutscene for each location, as well as some bonus ones! We also fixed some minor bugs.[/h3]

[h3]Now you can watch any cutscene through the main menu![/h3]

[list]
[*] [h3]Help Emperor Vladimir Defend Saint Petersburg from the Lizards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/02a426241889e962032e7aec2213fca6b72af420.png[/img]
[*] [h3]The United Lizard Flotillas of Nibiru and Mars have attacked Earth! Go on a journey and destroy the lizard bases![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/f8a25b24e07620286d40829d048e0aec10c047bb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/94e4f4af6e7a5761beac62092cef5abd54c33dec.png[/img]
[*] [h3]Celebrate the New Year 2024 with Emperor Vladimir, God Perun and the knights - Billyslav Herringtonov and Ivan Darkholmov[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/c483ecae1effbfbee64c2ee700eab6b4927016e6.png[/img]
[*] [h3]Go to Sauna with the Great Russian Knights ♂[/h3]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/dff632b809b7f1514c4e5358c92ffca5b114ba26.png[/img]

[h3]And more other cutscenes![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/8abb4194e6169b0319cca21941dc0b5178580ca1.png[/img]

[h3]Play and if you like it, please tell all your friends if you haven't already! And also we remind you that the game has a 40% discount, give your friends a great gift for the new year! Thanks![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/6b3b22420da5fa4a662a23293582cd22cf51cdd4.png[/img]

notes.title: GIveaway of 2x Steam Gift Cards and 100+ Keys
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, friends![/h3]

[b]UPD:

Friends, let's summarize the results:

Anyone who participated in the raffle can email dungeon.master.studio@gmail.com and get the keys for participating! Attach a link to your post to the message.

Steam gift cards get numbers:
#57 - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199523941803]https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199523941803[/url]
#18 - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198416140897]https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198416140897[/url]

- friend the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199042696187/]https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199042696187/[/url] and get your steam gift cards!

[b]Receipt of the prize is relevant for the next 7 days! Who will write later than January 21 - 21:00 Moscow time - will not get the prize! Have a nice day![/b]

Thank you all for participating! Good luck in future giveaways.[/b]

[list][*] [b]$5 Steam Gift Cards x2[/b]

[*] [b]100+ Steam Keys[/b]
[/list]

[h3]These prizes are Waiting For You! :)[/h3]

[b]Friends[/b], to take part in the [b]giveaway[/b], you should:

[olist]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230070/]Add the game to your Steam Wishlist[/url] (if it is not already in your Steam library)

[*] [b]Share this announcement with all who you knows! :)[/b]
Click "[b]Share[/b]" under this news, then "[b]Share directly to my status[/b]", write something and click "[b]Post[/b]"

[*] [b]Tell us your opinion about the game in the comments[/b] under this announcement! [b]We will be very happy to hear it from you![/b]

[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/6eafadb50d5228926cad543fe55acb1c4a5350c0.png[/img]

[h3]We will announce the results of the giveaway on [b]January 14 at 21:00 Moscow time[/b]! Good luck![/h3]

Guys, we also [b]would like to remind you in a friendly manner[/b] that we, as you [b]are waiting for[/b], and really want [b]to get that trading cards[/b] and [b]add new levels to the game[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/c6fc205a521911a3c61f70551263d680f9445968.gif[/img]

All this affects to [b]how fast[/b] we'll get [b]trading cards [/b]and this helps us to get them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/8d5cdaacceb9c39dc6400085decd2778a68172b5.gif[/img]

We will be [b]very gratefu[/b]l if you [b]tell your friends about the game[/b], write [b]your opinion in comments or reviews[/b] and [b]Add it to Your Wishlist[/b] if you're liked it!

[h3]Thanks![/h3]
